error_codes.name: InvalidArgument
doc: An argument is outside its documented range.

error_codes.name: Internal
doc: A bug inside teigeodata (a panic caught at the boundary, or a broken invariant).

doc: Most rows `sample_rows` builds in one call.

functions.name: version
doc: The library version, from its package metadata.

functions.name: noop
doc: Does nothing. Measures the bare cost of a call across each boundary.

functions.name: fold
doc: The search fold of a name: NFKD, lower case, optional accents dropped by script, spaces
collapsed, recomposed to NFC. The same fold the forge and the search index use.

doc: Builds `rows` deterministic sample places as a blob with the columns `id` (`u32`), `lat`

functions.name: progress
doc: Calls `on_step` once per step with the step number, from 1 to `steps`, on the calling
thread, and returns the number of steps run. Exercises callbacks in every binding.
